name: remove-openai-gemini-35
title: Remove OpenAI and standardize Gemini 3.5 Flash
description: Route all public runtime AI entrypoints through Gemini 3.5 Flash with local Ollama fallback where supported, while preserving deterministic business fallbacks.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Public chatbot and AI-table entrypoints now enforce Gemini; forecast, promotion, review insight, and profile rewriting use Gemini/shared client. Local fallback remains Ollama Qwen3 with BGE-M3 embeddings. No GraphQL schema, resolver contract, Apollo operation, UI action, restaurant scoping, permission, or persistence changes. No local build/tests or runtime Gemini API smoke test were available; GitHub exposed no status checks/workflow runs for the final merge commit.
